content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define organic chemistry and organic compounds
Explain why carbon forms so many compounds
Recognise the different types of formulae used in organic chemistry
Understand homologous series and functional groups
is the study of carbon compounds. Despite being just one element, carbon forms more compounds than all other elements combined. This is because of carbon's unique bonding properties.
Carbon has 4 electrons in its outer shell
It can bond to other carbon atoms
It can form chains, rings, and branches
Contain carbon, hydrogen, and other elements (O, N, S, halogens)
